states.name: desktop-body
states.snapshot:
- main:
  - paragraph: Sugata · captured wardrobe study
  - heading "Ink and denim" [level=1]
  - paragraph: A navy tee, tonal denim and warm brown shoes, with the chin-length bob and untinted Brown hair setting. These captured views use the current g050 body study.
  - link "Download this look":
    - /url: ink-denim.json
  - link "Wardrobe editor":
    - /url: /src/showcase.html
  - paragraph:
    - text: In the editor, choose
    - strong: Open settings (JSON) ↑
    - text: and select the downloaded file. It opens in Neutral Studio with the full outfit.
  - generic: Compare captured views
  - combobox "Compare captured views":
    - option "Full look" [selected]
    - option "Portrait"
  - region "Full look in two rooms":
    - figure "Neutral Studio · Full look Inspection lighting. View original image":
      - 'img "Neutral Studio full outfit: navy tee, denim and brown shoes"'
      - strong: Neutral Studio · Full look
      - text: Inspection lighting.
      - link "View original image":
        - /url: ../docs/evidence/nonhair-2026-10-03/ink-denim-look/archive/capture/neutral-body.png
    - figure "Kitchen · Full look Warmer, more shadowed room. View original image":
      - 'img "Kitchen full outfit: the same navy tee, denim and brown shoes"'
      - strong: Kitchen · Full look
      - text: Warmer, more shadowed room.
      - link "View original image":
        - /url: ../docs/evidence/nonhair-2026-10-03/ink-denim-look/archive/capture/kitchen-body.png
  - generic "Existing small smile · two separate stills"
  - heading "What these views show" [level=2]
  - paragraph: Colours vary with the room lighting; Neutral Studio is an inspection option, not colour calibration. Coarse hair cards, stipple and jagged neckline edges remain visible in the portraits.
  - paragraph: This is an optional clothing composition. These six captured views do not qualify other bodies, every angle, fit or continuous expression and movement.
  - paragraph:
    - link "Look guide and capture notes":
      - /url: INK-DENIM.md
